mentions.name: Gluten-free sourdough starter cultivation
mentions.description: This hobby project grows and nurtures sourdough starters optimized for gluten-free bread, cultivating several kinds to find out which taste the maker likes most, after discovering that different bacterial culture mixtures produce different dough flavors and that starter growth rate can be strengthened by optimizing external variables.
mentions.source_excerpt: my new hobby project is growing and nuturing sourdough that's optimized for gluten free bread, and I'm cultivating a couple of different kinds to find out which taste I like the most.
